title: Final Entropy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the change in entropy, Delta S, as given in the reference solution.

title: Temperature at x
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the temperature distribution T_x in the bar as a function of distance x from the cold end.

title: Average Temperature
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and calculate the average temperature T_f as (T_H + T_C) / 2.

title: Entropy Integral Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should set up the integral for the change in entropy correctly, relating it to the temperature distribution.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect limits of integration or sign mistakes in the entropy calculation.
